name: mailnext.draft-fixture-create
description: Create one blank unsent fixture draft with no recipients, body, attachments, or signature. Delete it using IDs returned by the same call.

name: mailnext.draft-fixture-delete
description: Delete one blank fixture draft only after a fresh native snapshot exactly matches its draft ID, thread ID, expected subject/body, and empty recipient/image/attachment state.

parameters.name: threadId
parameters.description: Exact native thread ID from the fresh fixture snapshot.

parameters.name: messageId
parameters.description: Exact native draft ID from the fresh fixture snapshot; this is the MAIL_DELETE_DRAFT messageId.

parameters.name: expectedSubject
parameters.description: Exact complete current fixture subject required before deletion.

parameters.name: expectedBodyHtml
parameters.description: Exact complete current fixture body HTML required before deletion.

name: mailnext.draft-fixture-update
description: Save restricted HTML to a freshly created blank fixture draft only. The parent supplies a fresh raw native snapshot to requestFromSnapshot; it verifies identity and expected prior body before preserving the complete safe fixture shape.

parameters.name: draftId
parameters.description: Exact ID returned by fixture creation.

parameters.name: threadId
parameters.description: Exact thread ID returned by fixture creation.

parameters.name: replyMessageId
parameters.description: Exact reply-message ID returned by fixture creation; may be empty for compose.

parameters.name: subject
parameters.description: New fixture subject, up to 512 characters.

parameters.name: bodyHtml
parameters.description: Restricted p/br/strong/em/u HTML, no attributes or resources, up to 16 KiB.

parameters.name: expectedSubject
parameters.description: Fresh snapshot subject required before mutation.

parameters.name: expectedBodyHtml
parameters.description: Fresh snapshot body required before mutation.

evidence.snippet: H5 serializes from/to/cc/bcc, bodyHtml, subject, images, attachments, docsPermissions, threadId, flags, and bodySummary

name: mailnext.signature-fixture-update-text
description: Replace text in one session-created signature fixture only. The parent supplies a fresh raw MAIL_GET_SIGNATURE snapshot to requestFromSnapshot, which requires an exact expected HTML match and preserves every other native signature field, including template JSON and images.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Non-empty text up to 20,000 characters; encoded as inert div HTML.

parameters.name: expectedTemplateHtml
parameters.description: Exact complete HTML from the fresh fixture snapshot, up to 120,000 characters.
